caption: Desk Routing as the incoming rule of a stage
preconditions: Seeded newsroom from tools/screenshots/SEED.md (desks Politics, Business, World, Culture, Sports with Story profile and story template)
The backend has the desk_routing macro (core superdesk/macros/desk_routing.py, label 'Desk Routing')
steps: Open #/settings/desks and wait for [data-test-id="desk--Politics"] to be visible

steps.script: const label = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-test-id="desk-config-modal"] label.sd-line-input__label')].find((l) => l.textContent.trim() === 'Incoming Rule'); const sel = label.parentElement.querySelector('select'); const opt = [...sel.options].find((o) => o.textContent.trim() === 'Desk Routing'); sel.value = opt.value; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true}));

notes: Edit mode of the Incoming with Incoming Rule set to 'Desk Routing'. Do not save the stage. Replaces image300.

caption: The Desk Router widget
preconditions: Seeded newsroom from tools/screenshots/SEED.md (desks Politics, Business, World, Culture, Sports with Story profile and story template)
Desk 'World' is open (not routing)
steps: if [data-test-id="dashboard"] does not show 'Desk Router', click button[aria-label="Add widget"] and click [data-test-id="widget-item"][data-test-value="close-desk"] and click the 'Add This Widget' button
wait for [data-test-id="dashboard-widget"][data-test-value="Desk Router"] to be visible

steps.script: const w = document.querySelector('[data-test-id="dashboard-widget"][data-test-value="Desk Router"] select'); const opt = [...w.options].find((o) => o.textContent.trim() === 'Culture'); w.value = opt.value; w.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true}));

steps: Confirm the 'Start routing' button is visible
notes: World is the source desk, Culture the target. Changing the select saves closed_destination on the World desk right away (needs the desk_routing privilege; admin has it). Adding the widget changes the World desk dashboard on the server; that is fine for the next two shots. Replaces image12, image344 and image358 (old UI, customer desk names).
